get.summary:
ListFeedback lists submitted feedback, newest first, so admins can review
and track user requests and issues. Admin only.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
status optionally filters the list to one triage state. Unset returns all.

 - FEEDBACK_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: FEEDBACK_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED is the zero value and is not valid input.
 - FEEDBACK_STATUS_OPEN: FEEDBACK_STATUS_OPEN means the feedback has not been handled yet.
 - FEEDBACK_STATUS_RESOLVED: FEEDBACK_STATUS_RESOLVED means an admin marked the feedback as handled.

post.summary: ResolveFeedback marks feedback as handled or reopens it. Admin only.

parameters.name: feedback_id
parameters.description: feedback_id is the id of the feedback to update. Required.

get.summary:
ListOutdatedReports lists parking lots with outstanding outdated reports
so admins can verify and resolve them. Admin only.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

get.summary:
ListParkingLotsForReview lists submissions for the admin review queue,
newest first. Admin only.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
status filters the queue by lifecycle state. Unspecified means
PENDING_REVIEW, the default queue view.

 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED is the default value; it is never used for
a real parking lot.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_PENDING_REVIEW: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_PENDING_REVIEW means the lot was submitted and awaits
review.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_APPROVED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_APPROVED means the lot passed review and is publicly
visible.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_REJECTED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_REJECTED means the lot was rejected and is only visible
to its submitter.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_DISABLED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_DISABLED means the lot was taken offline (closed,
verified as outdated, or moderated). It no longer appears in public
discovery; it remains visible to its submitter and to users who favorited
it.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

get.summary:
ListFavoriteParkingLots lists the caller's favorite parking lots, newest
favorite first.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

post.summary:
SubmitFeedback records a user's feature request or issue report so admins
can review it. The submitting user is taken from the request context.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: SubmitFeedbackRequest is the input to SubmitFeedback.

post.summary:
ReverseGeocode resolves a coordinate pair into a human-readable parking
lot location (POI name, address, city). The server holds the geocoding
service credentials; the mini program only sends its coordinates, so the
key never leaves the backend.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ReverseGeocodeRequest is the input to ReverseGeocode.

get.summary:
ListMyParkingLots lists the caller's submissions, including lots awaiting
review or rejected.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

post.summary:
CreateParkingLot submits a new parking lot for review. The lot is
immediately usable by its submitter and becomes publicly visible once a
reviewer approves it.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CreateParkingLotRequest is the input to CreateParkingLot.

get.summary:
GetParkingLot returns one parking lot. Pending and rejected lots are only
visible to their submitter (and reviewers); disabled lots are only visible
to their submitter and users who favorited them.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to fetch. Required.

delete.summary:
DeleteParkingLot deletes a parking lot owned by the caller. Only pending
or rejected lots can be deleted; approved lots must be disabled by an
admin instead.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to delete. Required.

put.summary:
UpdateParkingLot fully replaces a parking lot owned by the caller. Only
pending or rejected lots can be edited; editing resubmits the lot for
review and resets its outdated_report_count.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to update. Required.

post.summary: FavoriteParkingLot adds an approved parking lot to the caller's favorites.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to favorite. Required.

post.summary:
ReportParkingLotOutdated reports that an approved parking lot's
information is outdated. Each user can report a lot once; reports demote
the lot in nearby listings and surface a warning to other users.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot being reported. Required.

post.summary: ReviewParkingLot approves or rejects a pending submission. Admin only.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to review. Required.

post.summary: UnfavoriteParkingLot removes a parking lot from the caller's favorites.

parameters.name: parking_lot_id
parameters.description: parking_lot_id is the identifier of the lot to unfavorite. Required.

post.summary:
CheckCachedParkingLots is the lightweight staleness probe for the mini
program's local parking-lot cache. The client sends a snapshot of the
lots it cached (id + last-known updated_at); the server returns only the
ids whose cached copy is no longer current (content changed, or the lot
no longer exists), so the client can drop or refresh them. This keeps
the transfer tiny even with 100 cached lots.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CheckCachedParkingLotsRequest carries the client's cache snapshot.

get.summary:
ListNearbyParkingLots returns approved, enabled parking lots near the
caller's location, sorted by distance. Lots with outdated reports are
demoted.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description:
latitude is the caller's WGS-84 latitude used as the search anchor.
Required.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description:
longitude is the caller's WGS-84 longitude used as the search anchor.
Required.

parameters.name: pagination.page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

parameters.name: pagination.page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

parameters.name: radius_m
parameters.description:
radius_m bounds the search to parking lots within this many meters of the
anchor. Zero means "use the server default" (5000 m). Values are clamped
to the supported range [100, 50000]. This lets the mini program scope a
nearby search to its current city without a server round-trip.

v1Feedback.description: Feedback is one user-submitted feedback entry.

v1FeedbackStatus.description:
FeedbackStatus tracks the admin triage state of feedback.

 - FEEDBACK_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: FEEDBACK_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED is the zero value and is not valid input.
 - FEEDBACK_STATUS_OPEN: FEEDBACK_STATUS_OPEN means the feedback has not been handled yet.

FeedbackType discriminates the kind of user feedback.

 - FEEDBACK_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: FEEDBACK_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED is the zero value and is not valid input.
 - FEEDBACK_TYPE_FEATURE_REQUEST: FEEDBACK_TYPE_FEATURE_REQUEST is a feature request from a user.
 - FEEDBACK_TYPE_ISSUE: FEEDBACK_TYPE_ISSUE is a problem or bug report from a user.

Total number of items known at the time of the response. May be
approximate for very large collections.

v1Pagination.description: Pagination is the canonical request envelope for list RPCs.

id.description: id is the stable identifier of the parking lot.

name.description: name is the display name of the parking lot.

address.description: address is the human-readable location description of the parking lot.

latitude.description: latitude is the WGS-84 latitude of the parking lot entrance.

longitude.description: longitude is the WGS-84 longitude of the parking lot entrance.

cover_image_url.description: cover_image_url points to the cover image of the parking lot.

price_image_urls.description: price_image_urls point to images showing the pricing and charging rules.

payment_qr_image_urls.description: payment_qr_image_urls point to payment QR code images accepted at the lot.

status.description: status is the current lifecycle state of the parking lot.

review_comment.description: review_comment explains a rejection; empty for approved and pending lots.

submitter_id.description: submitter_id is the user who uploaded this parking lot.

created_at.description: created_at is when the parking lot was created.

updated_at.description:
updated_at is when the parking lot was last updated. Updating a disabled
or approved lot's content is not allowed; a resubmitted lot's content
update also refreshes this timestamp.

outdated_report_count.description:
outdated_report_count is the number of users that reported this lot as
outdated. It resets to zero when the submitter updates the content.

city.description:
city is the city where the parking lot is located; every address is
required to carry one so the mini program can filter its local cache to
the user's current city without a server round-trip.

v1ParkingLot.description:
ParkingLot is the domain entity of a parking lot: immutable facts plus
server-maintained state. Per-request view data (distance, per-caller flags)
lives in ParkingLotView instead.

name.description: name is the display name of the parking lot. Required.

address.description: address is the human-readable location description. Required.

latitude.description: latitude is the WGS-84 latitude of the parking lot entrance. Required.

longitude.description: longitude is the WGS-84 longitude of the parking lot entrance. Required.

cover_image_url.description: cover_image_url is an optional cover image.

price_image_urls.description:
price_image_urls point to images showing the pricing and charging rules.
Optional; at least one of price_image_urls and payment_qr_image_urls is
required.

payment_qr_image_urls.description:
payment_qr_image_urls point to payment QR code images accepted at the lot.
Optional; at least one of price_image_urls and payment_qr_image_urls is
required.

city.description: city is the city where the parking lot is located. Required.

v1ParkingLotDraft.description:
ParkingLotDraft is the user-editable content of a parking lot, used when
creating or updating a submission.

v1ParkingLotStatus.description:
ParkingLotStatus is the lifecycle state of a parking lot.

 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED is the default value; it is never used for
a real parking lot.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_PENDING_REVIEW: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_PENDING_REVIEW means the lot was submitted and awaits
review.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_APPROVED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_APPROVED means the lot passed review and is publicly
visible.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_REJECTED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_REJECTED means the lot was rejected and is only visible
to its submitter.
 - PARKING_LOT_STATUS_DISABLED: PARKING_LOT_STATUS_DISABLED means the lot was taken offline (closed,
verified as outdated, or moderated). It no longer appears in public
discovery; it remains visible to its submitter and to users who favorited
it.

parking_lot.description: parking_lot is the parking lot entity.

distance_m.description:
distance_m is the distance from the caller's location; only set for
nearby-list responses.

flagged_outdated.description:
flagged_outdated is true when the lot has at least one outdated report;
the frontend shows a "verify before use" hint when set.

favorited_by_me.description: favorited_by_me is true when the caller has favorited this lot.

outdated_reported_by_me.description:
outdated_reported_by_me is true when the caller already reported this lot
as outdated.

owned_by_me.description:
owned_by_me is true when the caller submitted this parking lot; the
frontend uses it to offer edit/remove actions on the caller's own lots.

v1ParkingLotView.description:
ParkingLotView wraps a parking lot with request-context data: distance from
the caller's location and per-caller flags. It is the response payload for
discovery and list RPCs; the wrapped ParkingLot carries domain fields only.

v1PingResponse.description: PingResponse is the output of Ping.

already_reported.description:
already_reported is true when the caller had already reported this lot;
repeat reports do not increment the count.

outdated_report_count.description: outdated_report_count is the updated report count.

ReviewDecision is the reviewer's decision for a pending submission.

 - REVIEW_DECISION_APPROVE: REVIEW_DECISION_APPROVE publishes the submission.
